races.paceDynamic: Blue Siam and Siorai will contest the early lead, with Blue Siam's proven front-running style likely to dictate a solid gallop from the outset. The honest pace will suit the strong contingent of hold-up horses (Watamu, Rose Light, Footage Detectives, Simply A Dancer) who need something to aim at in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse early
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Siam and Siorai go too hard early and fade before the straight
scenarios.body: The prominent racers inherit the lead turning in, with Tangled Webb and Nowherenearmilan best positioned. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the moderate pace that develops.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained honest gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Siam sets a solid but sustainable pace with Siorai tracking
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows hold-up horses to close strongly up the straight. Watamu's excellent recent form and Rose Light's consistency shine through late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Blue Siam dominates wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Siam gets first run and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Siorai and the prominent horses give chase but can't reel in the leader. The hold-up brigade are too far back to make serious inroads despite closing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Muddling pace tactical affair
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go conservative early creating a slow tempo
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle with positioning crucial. Prominent racers like Alibey and those with tactical speed benefit most from the sudden change of gear required.

watchPoints.text: Blue Siam and Siorai could burn each other out if they engage in early speed duel

races.paceDynamic: Hecouldbetheone will set a comfortable pace from the front with Demoiselle Kap likely settling prominently behind. With four of six runners preferring to be held up, this creates a tactical race where the pace-setters could steal a march if the hold-up horses don't time their challenges perfectly over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Hecouldbetheone gets an uncontested lead and quickens approaching two out
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds a decisive advantage turning for home while the hold-up quartet leave themselves too much to do. Demoiselle Kap chases hard but can't reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Horse Times It
scenarios.trigger: If Junker d'Allier gets the right racing room and delivers his challenge at the optimum moment
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner uses his superior ability to cut through the field from the back, overhauling Hecouldbetheone in the final furlong. His recent Soft ground form gives him the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Benefits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get in each other's way or meet interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Demoiselle Kap capitalizes on a perfect tracking position behind Hecouldbetheone to strike when the pace quickens. Her consistent placings suggest she's ready to convert one of these efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the outsiders gets a dream run through and the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: Either Embittered or Hara Kiri sneaks up the inner or finds a gap at the crucial moment when the principals have shot their bolt. The good ground particularly suits Hara Kiri's recent form pattern.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Hecouldbetheone gets more than two lengths clear turning for home as the hold-up horses may not have the pace to close
Monitor how smoothly Junker d'Allier travels in the early stages as he needs to be on the bridle to deliver his finishing kick
Check if Demoiselle Kap can track the pace without getting too keen as her prominent style depends on conserving energy
Observe whether any of the four hold-up horses can secure racing room in the straight as they'll all need clear runs
Note if Hara Kiri handles the faster ground in the early stages compared to his recent heavy ground success

races.paceDynamic: Happy And Fine will lead unopposed with Tapley likely tracking in second, creating a moderate tempo that suits the three hold-up horses behind. The small field and uncontested lead means the pace will be sustainable early, setting up a tactical finish where the closers Lunar Discovery, Classic King, and Kilbarry Hill can all get competitive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Happy And Fine gets an easy lead and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The leader builds a decisive advantage turning for home while the hold-up horses struggle to close the gap in time. Happy And Fine stays on strongly up the hill to hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the closers get clear runs from the back
scenarios.body: Classic King and Lunar Discovery benefit from the patient tactics as Happy And Fine weakens in the closing stages. The superior class horses come with strong finishing kicks to sweep past the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Tapley travels strongly behind Happy And Fine and jumps into contention
scenarios.body: Tapley moves smoothly into the lead approaching the final fence and uses good recent form to repel challenges. The prominent position proves ideal as both leaders and hold-up horses struggle to respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Happy And Fine stops quickly and Tapley also fades after setting fractions
scenarios.body: Kilbarry Hill emerges from the back as the other four all hit the wall simultaneously. The outsider benefits from the strongest staying power over this extended trip.

watchPoints.text: Happy And Fine's jumping under pressure - recent form shows question marks that could be exposed if challenged
Classic King's ability to get a clear run from hold-up position with only five runners creating potential traffic issues
Tapley's tactical positioning early - needs to be close enough to Happy And Fine without getting involved in pace battles
The pace through the middle stages - if too slow it will compromise all the hold-up horses' chances
Kilbarry Hill's stamina reserves - the outsider's only chance requires others to come back significantly

races.paceDynamic: Pottersjetamay will dictate from the front as the sole confirmed leader, likely joined early by prominent runners Klapton Boy, No Mean Feat, Global Eclipse and Beorma. With eight hold-up horses in the field, the early pace should be genuine but sustainable as Pottersjetamay won't face immediate pressure, setting up a tactical finish where positioning and jumping will prove crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Pottersjetamay gets an easy lead and the prominent runners don't pressure early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the hold-up brigade to close effectively. Pottersjetamay maintains momentum turning for home while the prominent runners battle for second.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Klapton Boy and No Mean Feat press Pottersjetamay from halfway, creating honest gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and favors horses with tactical speed over pure closers. One of the prominent runners kicks clear in the straight as hold-up horses struggle to bridge the gap.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hurricane
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses into a crawl with Pottersjetamay going too slowly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best jumpers with finishing kick dominate. Daring To Dream and Genbu benefit from their class and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners converge on Pottersjetamay early, creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The race fragments with no clear rhythm, suiting versatile types who can adapt. An outsider with good jumping finds the perfect trip through the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Easter Icon is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead alongside potentially Churchman or Farhh Echo in the early stages. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics, this creates a sustainable pace that will favor those who can quicken from off the pace, particularly the higher-rated hold-up horses like Harbour Light and Ballerina Boxer.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Easter Icon sets moderate fractions without pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the race to develop into a sprint finish where class tells. Higher-rated hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with plenty to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Easter Icon goes too slow and prominent runners fail to engage early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl until the final circuit, turning into a messy sprint where positioning matters more than class. Hold-up horses bunch up and struggle for racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If Churchman or Farhh Echo press Easter Icon from the early stages
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates a more genuine test of stamina over this extended trip. Those with proven staying power and tactical speed benefit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Problems
scenarios.trigger: If the large contingent of hold-up horses get shuffled back and encounter trouble in running
scenarios.body: Poor positioning and traffic issues compromise several fancied runners, allowing a horse that travels prominently to steal the race. Early position becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: Easter Icon's early fractions will dictate the entire race shape - if too slow, expect a messy finish
Traffic problems highly likely with seven hold-up horses in a ten-runner field causing potential trouble in running

Churchman's early positioning crucial as he could either press Easter Icon or drop back with the hold-up brigade
Ballerina Boxer's jumping and travel in the early stages will indicate if recent poor form can be reversed

races.paceDynamic: Duhallow Tommy, Gotthereintheend, and Ballyhiho will all want to lead from the start, creating a fierce early gallop that should stretch the field out quickly. The sustained pace over this stamina-sapping trip will set up a tactical battle between the hold-up horses Regal Renaissance and Two To Tango, who must overcome the testing pace to get competitive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Unsustainable Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If all three front runners (Duhallow Tommy, Gotthereintheend, Ballyhiho) engage in a speed duel through the first mile.
scenarios.body: The pace collapses after the second-last fence, allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Regal Renaissance and Two To Tango benefit most from their patient tactics as the early pace-setters fade badly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Duhallow Tommy or Gotthereintheend establishes a clear lead while the other pace-setters struggle to match the gallop.
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage jumping the last, with stamina reserves intact after avoiding the early battle. Politacus provides the main threat from his prominent position but cannot close the gap.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners maintain a fierce but sustainable pace without one breaking clear.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure stamina with all runners still in contention at the last fence. Gotthereintheend's recent winning form and Politacus's prominent style prove decisive in the final 100 yards.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Surprise Development
scenarios.trigger: If one of the supposed leaders drops back early or if jumping errors disrupt the expected pace dynamic.
scenarios.body: The race unfolds differently than expected, with Politacus potentially taking a more aggressive role or a hold-up horse positioned closer than usual. The tactical shake-up favors horses that can adapt quickly to changed circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Watch if all three of Duhallow Tommy, Gotthereintheend, and Ballyhiho are still disputing the lead after a mile as this will set up a collapse scenario
Monitor Regal Renaissance's position turning for home as he needs to be within striking distance despite his hold-up style to be competitive
Observe Gotthereintheend's jumping rhythm early as his recent winning form makes him dangerous if he settles better than his rivals
Check if Politacus can secure the ideal position behind the leaders as he lacks the pace to come from too far back
Watch for any early mistakes at the first few fences that could disrupt the expected pace battle between the front runners

races.paceDynamic: Three confirmed front runners (Telhimlisten, Caliach Point, Moon Over Clyro) will ensure a strong gallop from the start over this stamina-testing 2m2½f trip. With multiple pace angles and several hold-up horses including Juan Bermudez, Morning Mayhem and Soldier's Leap, the race sets up for a typical scenario where the early leaders set it up for closers. The strong pace should suit the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade if they can get into contention.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders (Telhimlisten, Caliach Point, Moon Over Clyro) go too fast early
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop takes its toll on the front rank over the final half-mile. Hold-up horses Juan Bermudez and Morning Mayhem time their runs perfectly to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of Telhimlisten or Caliach Point drops back early leaving moderate pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with prominent runners Oakley and Whatsgoingonmarvin able to position closer. Speed becomes more important than stamina in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Telhimlisten uses class advantage to control fractions and see off rivals
scenarios.body: The OR 110 rating tells as Telhimlisten dictates terms and has enough left to resist late challenges. Caliach Point and Moon Over Clyro fade after pressing throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Swoop Special
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly extreme and even prominent horses get involved too early
scenarios.body: Patient hold-up horses who settle furthest back get the perfect setup as everything comes back to them. Soldier's Leap and Get The Value benefit from the most extreme scenario.

watchPoints.text: Moon Over Clyro and Caliach Point both show limited good ground experience and could struggle if pace becomes genuine.
Juan Bermudez has poor recent course form (14th last time here) despite his hold-up style suiting the likely pace setup.
Telhimlisten's jumping under pressure as highest rated runner who will face sustained challenges from multiple angles.
Morning Mayhem's position turning for home as recent winner whose hold-up style needs the race to develop perfectly.
Soldier's Leap adapting to good ground having shown all recent form on softer surfaces.
